component.name: Tonearm
component.summary: Play your Kodi music library from anywhere

description.p: Tonearm is a music remote for Kodi: browse the music library of one or more Kodi systems and play it on them, from the desktop or a Linux phone.

ul.li: Spotlight on what's new, with jump back in, coming releases and radio picks
Albums and artists as grids or sortable, responsive lists
Genres, decades, recently and most played, favorites and playlists
Endless radio from a genre or a decade, and a sleep timer
Fuzzy search across artists, albums and songs
Offline cache with fast incremental library updates
Lock-screen and media-key controls via MPRIS

description.p: Genres and decades pages, separate Recently and Most Played sections, favorites for playlists, queue reordering, a sleep timer and many layout improvements.
